plugins.name: user-hd
plugins.description: A band above the Claude Code prompt: prompt-cache countdown with a 2-minute keep-warm alert, and handoff buttons (write one, read the newest).

plugins.name: pr-review-ui
plugins.description: PR reviews as numbered points in one standard format; the PR is checked out into a review worktree and each point's code opens beside the review with the changes highlighted: in your editor, in terminal-browser, or in a code pane.
